allocation.description: A declaration by the business of how the amount applied to this line item sits against the document. Paying a face amount does not establish what was owed; these figures are declared, not evidence.

amount_applied.description: Amount applied to this document by this line item, in minor units.

balance_after.description: Declared balance after. MUST equal balance_before minus amount_applied (rule 4).

balance_before.description: Declared balance on the document before this application, in minor units.

instalment_number.description: Instalment number of this application against the document, where the document is paid in instalments.

allocation.title: Allocation (declared)

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with a top-level invoice_reference, so the AP2 mandate extension's merchant signature over the checkout covers it.
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Invoice Reference

dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended with the checkout's invoice_reference as an unchanged snapshot. Later status evidence is stored beside the snapshot and never overwrites it.
dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Invoice Reference

document.description: The business's statement of the invoice document, checked against scheme evidence by the verifier. Amounts are integer minor units of the checkout currency.

issue_date.description: Issue date of the document (ISO 8601 calendar date).

issuer_tax_identity.description: The issuer's tax identity (for in_gst_einvoice_irp, the seller GSTIN).

number.description: Document number as issued (e.g. the invoice number carried in the scheme's signed artifact).

total.description: Invoice-only total in minor units. Within the v0.1 scope this is the total of the invoice lines referred to by this reference's entry set for this document; see the specification's scope and rule 2.

type.description: Document type code as used by the scheme (for in_gst_einvoice_irp, the signed artifact's DocTyp, e.g. INV).

document.title: Invoice Document

invoice_reference.description: Top-level field of the checkout and of the order. On the order it is a snapshot of the checkout's value, unchanged.
invoice_reference.title: Invoice Reference

invoice_reference_entry.description: One entry per checkout line item referred to an invoice. Where a registration is present, a status MUST be present (rule 6); not_established is always allowed and omission is invalid.

line_item_id.description: The id of the one checkout line item this entry refers to.

invoice_reference_entry.title: Invoice Reference Entry

registration.description: The scheme registration of the document. artifact_digest binds a signed scheme artifact that is supplied separately to authorised verifiers; raw scheme artifacts are NOT carried inline in the checkout or the order.

artifact_digest.description: Digest of the scheme's signed artifact, as 'sha256:' followed by the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact's exact bytes as supplied in the evidence bundle.

identifier.description: Registration identifier. For in_gst_einvoice_irp, the IRN (64 lowercase hex characters).

registered_at.description: Registration time, present only where the scheme evidence supplies it at usable precision. The signed QR artifact of in_gst_einvoice_irp supplies none, so it is omitted there.

scheme.description: Registration scheme. Version 0.1 defines one value: India's GST e-invoice system (Invoice Registration Portal).

registration.title: Registration

status.description: A claim by the business about the registration's status. It is never evidence by itself.

cancelled_at.description: Cancellation time, where the claim is that the registration was cancelled and the business states when.

observed_at.description: When the business made or observed this claim.

value.description: The claimed status. not_established is always allowed.

status.title: Status claim (by the business)

description: Extends dev.ucp.shopping.checkout and dev.ucp.shopping.order with a top-level invoice_reference: a per-line-item reference to an already-issued invoice, its scheme registration, and the business's status claim for that registration. Version 0.1 covers one scheme (India's GST e-invoice / IRP registrations), a merchant collecting its own issued invoice, invoice lines of quantity one, amounts in INR minor units, positive amounts, and no discount, tax or fee that changes the invoice-only total.
name: io.github.agorail-labs.shopping.invoice_reference
title: Invoice Registration Reference Extension
